workarounds.symptom: bug(sessions): delete still fails with "runtime ledger unavailable" — webui imports the Agent module removed in be3d6affc8
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sessions): retire gateway runtime rows through the current Agent entry point. Target files: api/models.py, tests/test_session_delete_real_agent_fence.py, tests/test_session_delete_runtime_ledger.py. Deleting a session that has gateway runtime rows (`session_admissions` / `worker_executions`) runs the Agent's retirement fence inside WebUI's delete transaction (`_retire_gateway_runtime_ledger` in `api/models.py`). The fence keeps terminal receipts as exact-retry evidence and refuses a delete while work is still live. (Ref: https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/9218)
